title: 2023 Banks — Synthetic Retrospective Point-in-Time Research Bundle
description: A fully offline teaching fixture for authenticated retrospective cutoff enforcement and evidence closure. Every number and record is invented for software testing. The name identifies the historical window being emulated; this pack is not evidence about any real bank, market participant, or 2023 event.

cutoff_policy.eligible_when: released_at <= information_cutoff AND vintage_at <= information_cutoff AND (ingested_at <= information_cutoff OR a synthetic-only proof is bound to the exact source, artifact hash, and source_published_at <= information_cutoff)
cutoff_policy.transitive_claim_policy: reject a claim if any evidence observation is not eligible
